title: The stacking number of a tree
summary: Csernák and Soukup introduced the stacking number of a graph: the least integer $t\ge2$ such that every configuration of $t$ pebbles can be transformed by pebbling moves into a configuration supported on one vertex. They conjectured an explicit formula for the stacking number of a tree in terms of the degrees of its vertices and their distances from a chosen root. We prove this conjecture for every finite tree with at least two vertices.
